summary.text: Michael Granger is a Republican state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 2 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Granger advanced from the Republican primary for Strafford 2, a three-seat district, in 2022, 2024 and 2026.
He was assigned to the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
Fellow incumbent Glenn Bailey, Mark Racic (R) and Larry Brown (D) are also on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the district.
